name: PitchPerfect
tagline: Practise hard workplace conversations against a simulated boss tuned to their personality.
problem: Tools help you prepare for interviews, not for tough conversations on the job.
solution: A questionnaire about your situation and boss generates a realistic scenario; you respond by text or voice and get feedback.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask a difficult boss for a raise and get coached.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH: Best Use of Auth0” among 131 submissions.
Finds an underserved moment: conversations after you are hired.

lessons: Look for the moment after the obvious one (interview → first raise).
